title: Compatible finite coordinates for a nilpotent module tower
statement: Let R_n be commutative rings with surjective transition maps φ_n and nilpotent kernels. Let N_n be finite-free R_n-modules with surjective φ_n-semilinear maps u_n and isomorphisms θ_n:R_n tensor_(R_(n+1)) N_(n+1)≅N_n whose ordinary adjoints equal u_n. There exist a natural r and R_n-linear coordinate equivalences e_n:N_n≃R_n^r for all n such that e_n(u_n(x))_j=φ_n(e_(n+1)(x)_j). No inverse-limit ring or module is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0CQF, compatible-basis argument in the proof

proof.text: Choose the finite arbitrary basis of N_0, whose index type is finite also for the zero ring, and reindex it using Fin(card I). Its coordinate equivalence gives e_0. For any chosen e_n apply the single-step nilpotent finite-basis lift with θ_n, its adjunction equation and the surjection u_n. Dependent recursion chooses e_(n+1) from that result. Its successor equation is exactly the required compatibility in every coordinate.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including HomologicalComplex.instHasLimit, instHasLimitsOfShape and AdicCompletion. These provide general limits but do not assert finite freeness, compatible markings, or the projection-compatible derived comparison.

mathlib_searches.query: A finite free module with a prescribed basis modulo a nilpotent ideal admits a lifting of that basis
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: formally smooth ring lifts, local-ring span of a lifted residue-field basis, Nakayama spanning-set lifts, adic lifts and idempotent lifting. None gives a prescribed finite basis lift for arbitrary commutative rings and nilpotent kernel.

mathlib_searches.query: nilpotent/jacobson with basis/free in Mathlib/RingTheory and Mathlib/LinearAlgebra; source MatrixComplexTower and MinimalMatrixComplex
mathlib_searches.results: No general basis lift found. The source invertible-matrix lift assumes local rings. Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex.fintype supplies the finite initial basis and includes zero rings; it is used for the tower induction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_compatible_finiteFree_module_coordinates
    (R : ℕ → Type u) [∀ n, CommRing (R n)]
    (φ : ∀ n, R (n + 1) →+* R n)
    (hsurj : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (φ n))
    (hnil : ∀ n, IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker (φ n)))
    (N : ∀ n, ModuleCat.{max u v} (R n))
    (uₙ : ∀ n, N (n + 1) ⟶ (restrictScalars (φ n)).obj (N n))
    (θₙ : ∀ n, (extendScalars (φ n)).obj (N (n + 1)) ≅ N n)
    (hterms : ∀ n, Module.Free (R n) (N n) ∧ Module.Finite (R n) (N n))
    (hsurju : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (uₙ n))
    (hθₙ : ∀ n, (extendRestrictScalarsAdj (φ n)).homEquiv
      (N (n + 1)) (N n) (θₙ n).hom = uₙ n) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (e : ∀ n, N n ≃ₗ[R n] (Fin r → R n)),
      ∀ n (x : N (n + 1)) j, e n (uₙ n x) j = φ n (e (n + 1) x j)
